The absence of Deep WM invasion, Ependymal (ventricular) Invasion, CET Crosses midline, Edema crosses midline, and midline_shift_present is less typical of an infiltrative aggressive IDH-wildtype pattern. Evidence against IDH-mutant includes Multifocal or Multicentric disease with Number of lesions of 2, substantial ED Volume (mL) and high Proportion of Oedema, plus a small NCR Volume (mL), which can be seen in more aggressive IDH-wildtype tumors. Overall, the frontal cortical, minimally enhancing, non-midline-crossing pattern outweighs the multifocal/edematous features, but uncertainty remains.

integrated_diagnosis: Oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted, CNS WHO grade 2

Evidence against co-deletion is limited but includes Multifocal or Multicentric disease with Number of lesions of 2 and substantial ED Volume (mL) with high Proportion of Oedema), which are not specific for oligodendroglioma and can be seen with non-codeleted diffuse gliomas. overall_comment: Predictions are based only on structured conventional MRI metadata. The main uncertainty is that multifocality and disproportionate edema are atypical for a straightforward low-grade oligodendroglial pattern, while the very small enhancing and non-enhancing core components and lack of midline/deep invasion argue against a clearly high-grade aggressive phenotype.
